ORDER TAKING STANDARDS

GREET

  • Greet within 10 seconds: “Hi, will you be using the mobile app today?”
  • NO INTERRUPTIONS! Let the guest finish — no “OK” or “Alright” between pauses — then ask clarifying questions

CLARIFYING QUESTIONS

  • Ask a specific: “Will that be Large?” “Will that be Coke?” “Will that be BBQ?” “Will that be Oreo?”
  • DO NOT ASK: What size? What drink? What sauce?
  • Happy Meals come with apples — DO NOT ASK

FINISH

Finally ask:

  • “Will that complete your order?”
  • “Is your order correct on the screen?”
  • “Would you like to round up your change for RMHC?”

Home Alone Meal

Crew Guide · Launches Tue Dec 1

What's in the Box
Breakfast

Any EVM breakfast entrée (guest's choice) · Hash Brown · Small coffee · 1 collectible in a blind box.

Breakfast platters are NOT included (Hotcakes, Big Breakfast, Gravy Biscuit).

Rest of Day

Any EVM entrée · Medium McShaker Fries · Medium drink · 1 collectible in a blind box · LTO sauce cup available.

How to Build the BoxBuild in this order, every time
Breakfast Box
  1. Collectible on the bottom right, placed vertically.
  2. 3 napkins (and any requested sauce).
  3. Entrée in the top left.
  4. Hash Brown on the bottom left.
  5. Presenter verifies the box before closing it.
Rest-of-Day Box
  1. Collectible on the bottom right, placed vertically.
  2. McShaker bag + seasoning packet next to the collectible.
  3. 3 napkins (and any requested sauce).
  4. Entrée in the top left.
  5. Fries on the bottom left.
  6. Presenter verifies the box before closing it.

The box stays open — the presenter verifies accuracy and closes the box before handing it to the guest. Every element goes inside the box.

McShaker Fries

Pre-stage McShaker bags with 1 seasoning packet inside each bag (bags and seasoning are for rest-of-day Holiday Meals only).

Use 2 fry scoops for McShaker Fries.

McShaker Fries CANNOT be added to a standard meal — they come with the Home Alone Meal or à la carte.

Key Rules

Ask every guest: “Will that be a Holiday Meal?” and ring meals as Holiday Meals.

Guests can choose ANY EVM entrée.

The LTO McNugget Sauce Cup is NOT automatic — it is a sauce option with McNuggets or McCrispy Strips, or à la carte.

Collectibles come in blind boxes: 4 designs, packed randomly — crew will not know which design is inside, and a specific design cannot be requested.

⚠ HEADS UP: McShaker Fries will NOT show on the fry station eProduction monitor. Watch for them on pick tickets.
The LTO McFlurryHot fudge, Oreo and M&M's — Mini and Regular

Fill soft serve to an inch above the fill line. Tap twice. Hot fudge: 1 pump (both sizes). Oreo: Regular 3 slides, Mini 2 slides. M&M's: 1 slide (both sizes). Blend: Regular 5–8 seconds, Mini 3+ seconds. Close the flaps and serve with a wrapped spoon.
